objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote: Let $B=\{b_1\ge\dots\ge b_r\}$ be a nonempty subset of LB's pieces with chain value $v=v(B)\le T_n$ (Theorem 4.2 with $S=1$, $m=n+1$).
objection.witness: Theorem 4.2 is stated for the chain value v(B) defined via the *decreasing* ordering, but its proof (via Lemma 4.1) only produces *some* ordering of P∪N with nested absolute difference g. The strategy section then writes B={b_1≥…≥b_r}. Purely cosmetic: the cut strategy is order-agnostic, so one need only say 'process B in the order supplied by Lemma 4.1'.
